tests.name: Intro gates attacks, then starts fighting
Movement is bounded and diagonal speed is normalized
Punch connects once during its active window
Attacks use true radial reach across the entire arena
Special meter is charged atomically and rejects insufficient energy
Dodge avoids an active hit and cannot repeat during cooldown
Jump rises, can attack in air, and lands
Blocking reduces damage and depleted guard breaks
Buffered J J K chains without an infinite stun lock
Simultaneous lethal attacks resolve as one drawn round
Best of three resets fighters and ends exactly once
Timeout compares health, including ties
Training revives opponent and never ends the match
Airborne knockout lands during the round result
Hard rival spends dodge meter to escape a completed pressure string
Seeded AI is reproducible and a long match keeps valid numbers
Every arena has full planar movement and safe fallback metadata
Attacks hit at all eight headings and knockback follows the impact
Committed strike cannot magnetically rotate to follow a sidestep
Timed guard parries for no chip and opens a counter window
Holding or repeatedly tapping guard cannot perpetually parry
Sprint is isotropic, drains energy and cannot bypass attack commitment
CPU reacts to a visible attack only after its difficulty latency
Reactor warning fixes its position and deals only one burst per fighter
Reactor can be escaped, jumped, and is harmless during training
Ascension upgrades apply only to the player and survive round resets
Invalid timing and non-finite movement input cannot poison the simulation
Difficulty defeats repeated button spam with better decisions, not hidden stats
